retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for 1960s-style performance art featuring a central figure in formal wear under stage spotlights with heavy, condensed block typography.
excludeWhen: bright daylight outdoor settings are requested
serif or script typography is the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A formal portrait of a male performer in a tuxedo seated on a high stool, centered within a dark stage environment. The composition is framed by large, vertically-stretched sans-serif text in the upper corners, utilizing both solid and outlined styles to create a balanced but asymmetrical typographic weight.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by a vertical stool against a dark, atmospheric background
High-contrast spotlighting creating a pool of light on the floor and rim lighting on the subject
Heavy typographic blocks in the upper third balancing the visual weight of the seated figure
A mix of solid and outlined letterforms creating depth and variety within a single typeface family
coreInvariants: Stage spotlighting with visible lens flare or light beams
Muted, cool-toned background palette contrasting with warm skin tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body seated figure centered horizontally, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high stool and the pool of white light at the subject's feet.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large bold text top-left, moves down to the subject's face, across to the outlined text top-right, and down to the tracklist details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows and out-of-focus audience areas provide significant negative space in the middle-ground.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft magenta and cyan (stage lighting highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the spotlight and the surrounding shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Flat-sided curves on characters like O and D
characterSpecificRedesigns: Y with a high junction point
S with very short horizontal terminals

treatment.fill: solid white or thin white outline

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and treatments (solid vs. outline) of the same ultra-condensed family.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed mid-century display feel.
Provides the clean, modern-retro condensed look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a tuxedo sitting on a high stool on a dark stage. Use a single overhead spotlight to create a bright circle on the floor and highlight his face. The background should show a dim, out-of-focus audience and stage lights with soft flares.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed sans-serif text in the top corners. The left block should be solid white; the right block should be a thin white outline of the same font. Align smaller sub-text blocks underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the text ultra-condensed and uppercase?
Is there a clear distinction between solid and outlined text?
Is the subject centered and seated?
Does the lighting feel like a theatrical stage?

adjustableVariables: Balance between solid and outlined text blocks
mustRedesign: Modern digital sans-serifs like Helvetica (too wide)
postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of both solid and outlined text
Ensure the spotlight creates a distinct pool of light
Confirm the subject is in formal attire
recipe.reuseFormula: Stage Portrait + Ultra-Condensed Typography + Spotlight Contrast = Mid-Century Performance Aesthetic
